customManagers.description: Track the Go toolchain version pinned in .mise.toml.
Track the golangci-lint version the custom-gcl binary is built from.
Track the golint-sl plugin version baked into custom-gcl.

packageRules.description: mise is pinned as MISE_VERSION in every workflow that sets it up; move them at once, and only to a release a day old, the age mise-action waited for before the pin.
Automerge digest, pin, patch, and minor updates once CI passes.
Keep major updates explicit.
Group GitHub Actions updates together.
Group Go module updates together.

Group Rust crate updates together. bindings/rust and examples/feature-flags share most crates, and families like wasmtime/wasmtime-wasi and opentelemetry/tracing-opentelemetry only build when they move in lockstep.
Group Node package updates for bindings/typescript and examples/alert-routing together.
The examples ship nothing, and release-please releases the whole repository from one package, so a fix(deps) there would cut a sigil release for an example app's dependency.
Leave engines.node alone. It is the oldest Node @spechtlabs/sigil supports, not the toolchain; raising it to the newest Node breaks consumers on older ones. Bump it by hand when support is dropped.
Rust is pinned in .mise.toml and in the examples/feature-flags/Dockerfile build image; move both at once. rust-version in the Cargo.toml files is the MSRV and is bumped by hand.
Node is pinned in .mise.toml and in the examples/alert-routing/Dockerfile build image; move both at once. On a major, bump the distroless nodejsNN runtime image there by hand.
bun is pinned in .mise.toml, in the examples/alert-routing/Dockerfile bun stage, and as @types/bun; move them at once.
The golang build images in the example Dockerfiles follow the Go toolchain in .mise.toml and go.mod.
The examples' compose stacks pin the same Grafana images; examples/feature-flags/.mise.toml pins k6 to the compose k6 image.
k6 in examples/feature-flags/.mise.toml goes with the compose k6 image, whatever package name the mise manager resolves it to.
Update .mise.toml and go.mod Go versions together.

Leave the go directive in go.mod alone. It is the minimum language version, not the toolchain; bumping it to a full patch version (1.27 -> 1.27.1) makes it equal to the toolchain directive and go mod tidy then deletes the toolchain line. Renovate tracks the exact version through the toolchain directive instead.
golangci-lint is pinned in .mise.toml and .custom-gcl.yml; the two must never disagree.
golint-sl is pinned in .custom-gcl.yml and .pre-commit-config.yaml; move both at once.
The commit message check must parse with the release-please version the release-please action bundles (see its package-lock.json), not the newest one. Bump it by hand alongside the action.
Group docs site dependencies together.

Hold the docs site on TypeScript 6 and below. TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and has no JavaScript API, and @vue/compiler-sfc reads files through that API (ts.sys) to resolve the imported prop types in the theme's components, so the docs build fails on it. Lift this once @vue/compiler-sfc no longer needs it.
